devices.name: Roku
devices.answer: Roku is the simplest streaming platform: a plain grid of apps, support for almost every service, and players from a basic HD stick to the Ethernet-equipped Roku Ultra. It suits people who want a neutral device that does not push one company's services.

models.name: Roku Streaming Stick
models.specs: HD streaming stick, powered from the TV's USB port, voice remote.

models.name: Roku Streaming Stick Plus
models.specs: 4K HDR stick, voice remote with TV controls.

models.name: Roku Streaming Stick 4K
models.specs: 4K with Dolby Vision and HDR10+, long-range Wi-Fi receiver in the cable.

models.name: Roku Ultra
models.specs: Fastest Roku player, Ethernet port, Wi-Fi 6, rechargeable backlit voice remote.

good: Simple home screen that you can keep focused on apps
Works with nearly every streaming service
Free live channels in The Roku Channel
watch: The home screen shows ads and sponsored rows
The cheapest sticks do not support 4K
devices.best_for: Anyone who wants an easy, brand-neutral device, including less technical family members.

devices.name: Amazon Fire TV
devices.answer: Fire TV devices are the natural pick for Amazon Prime and Alexa households. The Fire TV Stick 4K Max is the strongest stick in the range, and the Fire TV Cube adds hands-free Alexa and an Ethernet port.

models.name: Fire TV Stick 4K
models.specs: 4K with Dolby Vision, HDR10+ and Dolby Atmos.

models.name: Fire TV Stick 4K Max
models.specs: Faster processor, Wi-Fi 6E, Ambient Experience art screens.

models.name: Fire TV Cube
models.specs: Hands-free Alexa, Ethernet port, HDMI input for a cable box.

good: Tight Prime Video and Alexa integration
watch: The interface promotes Amazon content and ads heavily
Less useful if you do not use Amazon services
devices.best_for: Prime members and homes that already use Alexa speakers.

devices.name: Apple TV 4K
devices.answer: Apple TV 4K is the premium streaming box: the fastest hardware of the major platforms, no ads on the home screen, and deep iPhone, AirPlay and HomeKit integration. It costs more than sticks, so it makes most sense in Apple households.

models.name: Apple TV 4K (Wi-Fi)
models.specs: A15 Bionic chip, 4K Dolby Vision and HDR10+, Dolby Atmos, 64GB.

models.name: Apple TV 4K (Wi-Fi + Ethernet)
models.specs: Adds Gigabit Ethernet, Thread smart home radio and 128GB.

good: No ads on the home screen
AirPlay from iPhone, iPad and Mac, plus a home hub for HomeKit
watch: Highest price of the four platforms
Fewest benefits if you use Android phones
devices.best_for: iPhone users and anyone who wants the cleanest, fastest experience.

devices.name: Google TV Streamer
devices.answer: The Google TV Streamer replaced the Chromecast line. It runs Google TV, which pulls shows from all your services into one set of recommendations, and it doubles as a Matter and Thread smart home hub. Walmart's cheaper onn devices run the same Google TV software.

models.name: Google TV Streamer
models.specs: 4K HDR with Dolby Vision, Ethernet port, Matter and Thread hub, remote finder button.

models.name: Walmart onn 4K Pro (Google TV)
models.specs: Budget Google TV box with hands-free voice, sold by Walmart. Walmart raised its price to $69.98 in November 2026.

good: Built-in Chromecast casting from phones and Chrome
watch: The home screen is busy with recommendations
Chromecast-branded models are no longer sold new by Google
devices.best_for: Android and Google Home users who like content suggestions across services.
